title: Mite Maze
subtitle: Branith's Staff and Shirt, Mite Warrior Queen
steps: In the Facility Hub, ask the Warden about the Mite Maze (level 30+).
Find one of Branith's possessions (Staff or Shirt).
Show it to the Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Quest items
notes.body: Branith's Staff and Branith's Shirt are placed in the maze. Either one counts. The Warden also lists a Mite Queen's Staff, which the data does not place and probably drops from the Mite Warrior Queen (inferred).

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Mites resist everything a little: cold 0.75, slash 0.7, electric 0.8. Fire and acid are 1.0, so avoid them.

notes.title: Locked door
notes.body: One door near the upper portal room needs a master key.

notes.title: Trap drops
notes.body: Both Surface portals drop you outdoors at the Lost Wish Mountains.
